Tattvavaiśāradī
------------------------------------------
The Yogasūtras of पतञ्जलि (200 B. C.) is the basic work of योग philosophy, one of the six systems of Hindu philosophy.
This has a commentary called Vyāsa-bhāṣya by one व्यास (A.

) has written a learned gloss known as Tattvavaiśāradī. This is considered a standard elucidation of not only the Vyāsabhāṣya but also of योग philosophy itself.
See also YOGADARŚANA.
